{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABZYrdEw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhDAA34", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 45, "title": "Implement 8253 binary mode-2 rate generation, deferred reload and IRQ0 edges", "body": "## Problem

The PIT treats every nonzero mode as the same periodic countdown. DOS software selecting mode 2 therefore receives incorrect output timing and count-update behavior.

At baseline `77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942`, [Counter::write](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/src/devices.rs#L167) immediately replaces the active count. `Counter::tick` toggles OUT once whenever a batch crosses expiration, regardless of how many periods elapsed. [Bus::tick](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/src/bus.rs#L313) converts its boolean result into IRQ0.

This Issue implements one bounded part of PIT functionality: binary mode-2 counting and OUT behavior with GATE held high, plus channel-0 interrupt integration.

## Expected outcome

Implement these mode-2 semantics from Intel’s [8253/8253-5 datasheet: control-word format, Counter Loading and Mode 2](https://web.cecs.pdx.edu/~mpj/llp/references/8253.pdf):

- Mode encodings `010` and `110` select mode 2. Binary zero represents 65,536.
- Programming the mode sets OUT high. Initial counting begins after the specified clocked load, rather than consuming the load clock as a decrement.
- For divisor N, OUT is high for N−1 clocks and low for one clock; pulses repeat every N clocks.
- A completed count rewrite during an active period changes the following period without restarting the current one. Preserve the distinction between the programmed reload and live count.
- Supported byte-loading forms and ordinary count-latch reads operate on this state without changing its elapsed-clock progression.

Feed actual OUT0 rising transitions into the existing PIC request path, including a programming-induced rise when OUT0 was low. A held-high output must not repeatedly request interrupts. Intel’s [8259A datasheet, IR inputs and Edge and Level Triggered Modes](https://courses.cs.washington.edu/courses/cse451/25wi/documentation/8259A.pdf#page=17) specifies rising-edge recognition and no retrigger from a continuously high input.

Retain the current guest-clock conversion and PC-98 port mappings. Batched advancement must preserve final count/output state and report whether a rising transition occurred, even when several transitions fall inside one batch. The existing PIC latches requests; it must not acquire an artificial backlog of elapsed timer interrupts.

Scope excludes external GATE wiring/retriggering, BCD, divisor-1 accuracy, other mode corrections, general latch/read-write interleaving fixes, beeper mixing changes and instruction-cycle accuracy. Shared counter code may support mode 2 on all three channels; channel-1 audio fidelity is not established by this Issue.

## Context and reproduction

Existing [core PIT coverage](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/tests/core.rs#L239) programs mode 3. The [timer slice-determinism test](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/tests/timer.rs#L252) also uses mode 3, while the original PIC probes use mode 0. Inspection found no dedicated mode-2 acceptance.

A source-derived minimal reproduction, not executed by this evaluator:

```rust
let mut b = pc98_rust::bus::Bus::default();
b.output(0x77, 0x14); // channel 0, LSB only, binary mode 2
b.output(0x71, 100);
b.tick(40);
let active = b.pit.c[0].remaining;
b.output(0x71, 200);
assert_eq!(b.pit.c[0].remaining, active);
```

The current implementation replaces the active value with 200 immediately. The new regression should demonstrate failure on the unchanged baseline and success after implementation.

Project progress: supplied history records Issue #43/PR #44 merged at this baseline. Source inspection confirms independent PIC special-mask state and shared mask-aware ISR selection. The [Coordinator’s validation record](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/docs/validation.md#issue-43-review-revision-automatic-fixture-mirrors-2026-10-23) reports 160 native integration tests, including 20 PIC tests, and 62 production-Wasm browser tests passing without skips. These were not rerun here; supplied evidence contains no submitted independent PR review or confirmed publication-time CI success. All 26 inventory scopes and statuses remain unchanged. No supplied open Issue or recent improvement duplicates this mode-2 work.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement the specified mode-2 behavior in original Rust. Add focused original tests in `tests/pit.rs`, executable with `cargo test --locked --test pit`, including the baseline-failing reproduction above.
- [ ] Provide specification-derived clock/count/OUT traces covering divisors 2, 3, 4, 65,535 and encoded zero; both mode encodings; LSB, MSB and LSB/MSB access; initial loading; boundary rewrites; multiple completed rewrites; and an ordinary latched read. Keep expectations independent of implementation helpers.
- [ ] Compare single-clock advancement with irregular batches, zero advancement and a large batch spanning many periods. Require equivalent final device state and equivalent aggregate edge indication, including a batch containing a complete low pulse. Preserve fractional clock accumulation and bounded arithmetic/execution.
- [ ] Exercise both profiles and both port banks (`71h–77h` and `3FD9h–3FDFh`). Verify channel isolation, programming-induced OUT0 transitions, periodic IRQ0 timing, PIC mask/IRR/ISR/EOI behavior, IF/HLT interaction and reset clearing pending mode-2 state. Distinguish setup transitions from counted periodic pulses.
- [ ] Add a separate original MIT assembly boot probe with offline assembly preparation and a checked manifest recording source/image hashes, license, assembler command, result layout and execution budget. The guest must distinguish deferred reload from immediate restart through counter reads and service at least two periodic hardware IRQ0 entries using EOI/IRET. It must own all result and guard bytes; hosts must not inject IRQs or fabricate results.
- [ ] Boot that identical probe image natively and through production release Wasm on VM and Ap, before/after reset, at both browser URL roots. Require deterministic guarded results, `PIT MODE2 PASS`, no FAIL/host/browser error, unchanged disk bytes and completion within a declared maximum of 2,000,000 scheduler slots per boot. Register preparation and browser coverage in existing CI.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs the existing [README reproduction sequence](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/77088025d060023d0bdcf1b4d5c4acc46db4e942/README.md#reproduce-the-checks), plus the new probe preparation and focused tests: legal fixture preparation, `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, media/font reproducibility checks and `npm test`. Preserve existing PIT/beeper, BIOS interval, PIC/SMM, interrupt-shadow, DOS/application, VM and game assertions and budgets. Report exact commands, failures, skips and final outcomes; do not silently omit fixtures or tests.
- [ ] Update hardware/validation documentation with implemented behavior and actual evidence. PIT remains partial: other mode-specific behavior, external gates, BCD, comprehensive latch/sequencing behavior and mode-accurate beeper mixing remain outstanding. Preserve every fixed inventory category and scope. Limited probes and existing six-game reports do not establish full accuracy or commercial compatibility. Acceptance uses original or licensed source-built guests without proprietary ROM acquisition.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
